observations: Photo 0 shows a large TV screen displaying a nature scene with mountains and birds, with a Hisense E7H Vidaa Smart OS interface on the right side. The screen is labeled 'UHD 4K'.
Photo 1 shows the same TV displaying a harbor scene with colorful buildings and boats, with the same Hisense E7H interface visible. The screen also shows 'UHD 4K'.
The TV has a thin bezel, consistent with a frameless design.
The TV is on a stand with visible legs, and cables are visible on the floor.
The brand 'Hisense' and model 'E7H' are clearly visible on the screen interface in both photos.
The screen size is not visible on the TV itself, but the seller claims 65 inches.
The TV appears to be turned on and functioning in both photos.
The background shows a domestic setting with furniture and a fan, suggesting the TV is in use.

claims.claim: UK neatly used 65inches Hisense frameless UHD 4k smart TV
claims.evidence: The brand and model (Hisense E7H) are supported by the screen interface in both photos. The 'UHD 4K' label is visible. The frameless design is visually consistent with thin bezels. The 65-inch size is not visible on the TV or in the photos, so it is unverified. 'Neatly used' and 'UK' cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The TV may have screen damage, dead pixels, or backlight issues not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the screen showing the entire surface under bright light, or a video of the screen displaying a solid white or black screen.

risks.risk: The TV may not be 65 inches as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the TV next to a known object of known size (e.g., a ruler, a standard A4 paper, or a door frame) to confirm the diagonal measurement.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly smaller than claimed

risks.risk: The TV may have physical damage to the frame, stand, or ports not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: Photos of the back, sides, and stand of the TV, including close-ups of any ports or connections.

risks.risk: The TV may not be in working condition despite being turned on in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV powering on, navigating the menu, and playing content from different sources (e.g., HDMI, USB, streaming app).

proof_requests: Photo of the TV's back and sides showing ports and condition.
Photo of the TV next to a known object to confirm 65-inch size.
Close-up photo of the screen under bright light to check for damage or dead pixels.
Video of the TV powering on, navigating the menu, and playing content.
response.reason: The brand and model are confirmed from the screen interface, but the 65-inch size and condition claims are unverified. Hidden risks such as screen damage, incorrect size, and physical defects cannot be assessed from the current photos. Proof is needed to confirm the size, condition, and functionality before pricing.
